発見した「黄金航路」の報告を行います。
報告を行うと一定期間、黄金航路発見報奨金を受け取ることができます。
１度報告した黄金航路を再度、報告することはできません。
→[[141|黄金航路の記録]]　→[[201|黄金航路の発見]]

records.source_meaning: Control Pad steers;L1/R1 change sail direction;Touch Screen also moves ship. Circle opens/speedsup,cross closes/slowsdown. Sails leaveport halfopen;circle fullyopens. Withhalfopen sails andhandlers ateverymast,direction adjustsautomatically. Physical controls androlelabel requirebinding.
records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
船の移動（通常航海）
通常航海では十字ボタンで舵、L1R1で帆の向きを操作して船を進めます。[[101|タッチスクリーン]]でも進めます。○と×で帆の開きを切り替えます○＝帆を開く（スピードアップ）
×＝帆を閉じる（スピードダウン）
出港時の帆は半開です。○で全開になります。【！】半開のときは、マストすべてに[[125|操帆手]]がいると帆の向きは自動で操作されます。
records.current_English:
Manual Movement 
During normal sailing, steer with the 
D-pad and adjust the sails with L and R.
You can also steer[[101| with the touchscreen.]]
Opening the sails increases speed;
closing them reduces it. Ships leave port 
with their sails Half Open. Open them to
change to Full Open. While Half Open, the 
sails adjust automatically if every mast
has [[125|a Sail Handler.]]
records.heading: Manual Sailing
records.english: During normal sailing, steer with the D-pad and adjust the sails with L and R. You can also steer [[101|with the touchscreen]]. Press A to open the sails and speed up, or B to close them and slow down. Ships leave port with their sails Half Open. Press A to change to Full Open. While Half Open, the sails adjust automatically if every mast has [[125|a Sail Handler]].

records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
船の移動（自動移動）
「自動移動」では、船は自動で進みます。
×を押すと、自動移動がキャンセルされ[[83|通常航海]]になります。洋上では、自動移動を再開できません。
【！】「大鷲の像」を船に装備していると、自動移動時の時間経過が高速になります。通常の時間経過に戻すには、自動移動中に○を押します。
records.current_English:
Auto Movement
 The ship follows its route automatically.
 Press X to cancel and sail manually. Auto Move cannot restart at sea.
 [Tip] The Eagle Statue speeds time during Auto Move. Press A for normal time.
records.heading: Auto Move
records.english: The ship follows its route automatically. Press B, then confirm with A to cancel Auto Move and return to [[83|manual sailing]]. You cannot restart Auto Move at sea. [Tip] If your ship has an Eagle Figurehead fitted, time passes faster during Auto Move. Press A during Auto Move to restore normal time.

情報モード（洋上コマンド）
航海中に□を押すと、ポーズがかかり、情報モードになります。情報モードでは画面上の街や船の情報を見られます。
探索モードや宣戦モードへは、情報モードから移行します。

records.current_English:
info Mode (At Sea)
 Press Y to pause and inspect cities and ships on screen.
 Search and Declare War begin from info Mode.
 Choose Search or Declare War.
records.heading: Info Mode (At Sea)
records.english: Press Y to pause and inspect cities and ships on screen. From Info Mode, choose [[86|Search]] or [[87|Declare War]].

records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
探索モード（洋上コマンド）
船の周囲を探索します。
[[85|情報モード]]で□かR1を押すと、探索モードになります。○で探索を実行します。
探索の結果、水・食料・アイテムなどが見つかることがあります。見つからなかったときは、水夫の疲労度が３上がります。探索途中で水夫が脱走したり、獣に襲われたりすることもあります。
records.current_English:
Search Mode (At Sea)
 Search around the ship.
 from info Mode press Y or R, then A to search.
 You may find water, food, or items. A failed search adds 3 fatigue and may cause desertion or animal attacks.
records.heading: Search Mode (At Sea)
records.english: Search around the ship. From [[85|Info Mode]], press Y or R to enter Search Mode, then press A to search. You may find water, food or items. A failed search adds 3 fatigue. Sailors may desert or be attacked by wild animals while searching.

records.source_meaning: InInfo,square twice orL1 entersDeclareWar;choosing fleet/town startsbattle. AutomaticallyAtWar andlargeFriendshipdrop;towncommandsrestricted. Cannotdeclareagainst analliedfleet;do notbroadenallianceban totowns. Bindcontrols/state/metric.
records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
宣戦モード（洋上コマンド）
画面上の艦隊・街に[[89|戦闘]]をしかけます。
[[85|情報モード]]で□を２回またはL1を押すと、宣戦モードになります。攻撃対象を選ぶと、戦闘開始です。
宣戦すると、自動的に相手勢力との関係が「[[187|交戦中]]」になり、友好度が大きく下がります。
街に宣戦すると、その街で使えるコマンドは制限されます。
同盟中の勢力の艦隊には宣戦できません。
records.current_English:
Declare War Mode
 Attack a ship or city on screen.
 from info Mode press Y twice or L, then select a target.
 Relations become At War and fall sharply.
 Attacking a city limits its commands.
 Allied fleets cannot be attacked.
records.heading: Declare War Mode
records.english: Start a [[89|battle]] with a fleet or town on screen. From [[85|Info Mode]], press Y twice or L, then select a target to begin. Declaring war puts you [[187|at war]] with that faction and greatly reduces your friendship rating. Declaring war on a town limits its commands. You cannot declare war on an allied fleet.

records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
村
航海中に発見することがあります。
村では、食料や水を譲ってもらえたり、船を修理してもらえたりします。助けてもらったときは、金貨数枚を村人に渡します。
【！】村を発見すると、付近の土地や海が航路図で表示されるようになります。
【！】村では「[[102|約束の言葉]]」というパスワードについて質問されます。パスワードを入力すると、イベントが起こります。
records.current_English:
Village
 Villages may be found while sailing.
 They may provide water, food, or repairs for a few coins.
 [Tip] Discovery reveals nearby land and sea on the chart.
 [Tip] Entering the promised password may start an event.
records.heading: Village
records.english: You may discover villages while sailing. Villagers may give you food or water, or repair your ships. You give them a few gold coins in return for their help. [Tip] Discovering a village reveals nearby land and sea on the Route Map. [Tip] Villagers ask for a password called [[102|Promised Words]]. Enter the correct password to trigger an event.
records.finding: Restore the gold gift inreturn forhelp,Route Map andthe actual Promised Words feature label. A correct password triggers anevent;the source isnot merelya chance aftercorrect entry. Do notpromise particular rewards orimmediate trading fromthis village introduction.

戦闘
関係が「[[187|交戦中]]」の勢力の艦隊やサメなどに洋上で出会うと、戦闘になります。

Battle
 Meeting an enemy or monster starts battle.
 You move ships as in manual sailing; guns and other attacks are automatic.
 See Battle Start, Victory, and Defeat,
 plus Battle Actions.

records.english: Encountering a fleet you are [[187|at war]] with, or a monster such as a shark, starts a battle. You move ships as in [[83|manual sailing]]; guns and other attacks are automatic. See [[90|Battle Start]], [[91|Victory]] and [[95|Defeat]], plus [[96|Battle Actions]].

records.source_meaning: Four triggers:encounterAtWar fleet,declareagainstotherfleet,attackedbytown(enemyexclusivecontract towns attacknearby),monstersattack. Allthree original links.
records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
戦闘の発生条件
次のいずれかのとき、戦闘となります。
１．[[187|交戦中]]の勢力の艦隊と出会ったとき。
２．他勢力の艦隊に[[87|宣戦]]したとき。
３．街に攻撃をしかけられたとき。（交戦中の勢力が[[151|独占契約]]している街に近づくと、攻撃をしかけられます）
４．サメなどの怪物に襲われたとき。
records.current_English:
Battle Start
 Battle begins when:
 1. You meet a faction at war.
 2. You declare war on a fleet.
 3. A city attacks you, often near an enemy monopoly.
 4. A monster attacks.
records.heading: Battle Start
records.english: Battle begins when you encounter a fleet you are [[187|at war]] with, [[87|declare war]] on another faction's fleet, come under attack by a town, or are attacked by a monster. Towns under an enemy faction's [[151|exclusive contract]] attack when you approach.
records.finding: Replace often near an enemy monopoly withthe source's specific hostile exclusive-contract approach condition. Preserve all four triggers andthree links;do not substitute a probability orshare threshold.

 Conditions depend on the enemy.

 or Monster Battle.
